name: Jaipur
tagline: The historic Pink City of royal palaces and lively bazaars.
overview: Jaipur blends historic Rajput architecture, bustling street markets, and distinctive Rajasthani cuisine. It is ideal for heritage walks, craft shopping, and palace explorations.

activities.name: Amber Fort & Palace
activities.short_desc: Majestic hilltop fort built from yellow and pink sandstone with panoramic lake views.
activities.tips: Arrive before 9:30 AM to beat the mid-day heat and large tour buses.

activities.name: Panna Meena ka Kund
activities.short_desc: An intricately structured 16th-century stepwell near Amber with geometric stair patterns.
activities.tips: Great for calm photography; respect local signage regarding stairs.

activities.name: City Palace & Museum
activities.short_desc: Sprawling royal complex showcasing courtyards, textiles, royal armory, and Peacock Gate.
activities.tips: Composite ticket includes Jaigarh Fort within a 2-day validity period.

activities.name: Jantar Mantar Observatory
activities.short_desc: UNESCO World Heritage site featuring nineteen astronomical instruments built by Maharaja Sawai Jai Singh II.
activities.tips: Hire an audio guide to truly appreciate the geometric timekeeping science.

activities.name: Hawa Mahal & Wind View Cafe
activities.short_desc: The iconic Palace of Winds with 953 honeycomb windows designed for royal women to view city life.
activities.tips: Rooftop cafes directly across the road offer the best view and cold coffee.

activities.name: Bapu & Johari Bazaars Walking Tour
activities.short_desc: Vibrant street markets known for blue pottery, block-printed fabrics, and traditional mojaris.
activities.tips: Polite bargaining is customary; sample kachoris at Laxmi Mishthan Bhandar (LMB).

activities.name: Nahargarh Fort Sunset Point
activities.short_desc: Perched on the Aravalli hills, offering an uninterrupted panorama of the illuminated city below.
activities.tips: Pre-arrange your return auto-rickshaw or taxi as evening transit down the hill is sparse.

activities.name: Galtaji Temple (Monkey Temple)
activities.short_desc: Ancient pilgrimage site set between granite cliffs with sacred natural springs and shrines.
activities.tips: Keep food and shiny items tucked away securely inside your bag.

activities.name: Patrika Gate & Jawahar Circle
activities.short_desc: Stunning hand-painted archway showcasing Rajasthan's architectural legacy and vibrant motifs.
activities.tips: Early mornings have soft golden sunlight and no crowds.

activities.name: Chokhi Dhani Ethnic Cultural Village
activities.short_desc: Immersive Rajasthani village experience with folk dances, camel rides, and traditional thali.
activities.tips: Opens in the evening around 5:30 PM; come hungry for the grand dinner.

name: Goa
tagline: Sun-drenched beaches, Portuguese heritage, and relaxed coastal culture.
overview: From serene South Goan bays to historic churches and energetic North Goa seaside shacks, Goa offers a balanced mix of leisure, watersports, and colonial architecture.

activities.name: Fontainhas Latin Quarter Walk
activities.short_desc: Wander through pastel-painted Portuguese villas, cobblestone alleys, and cozy bakeries.
activities.tips: Try warm Bebinca and cashew cookies at Confeitaria 31 de Janeiro.

activities.name: Basilica of Bom Jesus & Se Cathedral
activities.short_desc: 16th-century UNESCO World Heritage churches representing the height of Manueline and Baroque architecture.
activities.tips: Dress modestly (shoulders and knees covered) for religious sanctum entry.

activities.name: Fort Aguada & Lighthouse
activities.short_desc: Well-preserved 17th-century coastal fortress overlooking the Arabian Sea with freshwater springs.
activities.tips: The upper fort offers broad panoramic views; visit late afternoon for milder heat.

activities.name: Sahakari Spice Farm Tour & Lunch
activities.short_desc: Guided walk through organic vanilla, pepper, and nutmeg plantations followed by Goan buffet.
activities.tips: Includes a welcoming herbal tea and authentic Saraswat/Goan fish or veg lunch.

activities.name: Anjuna Flea Market / Sunset Promenade
activities.short_desc: Eclectic market stalls offering handicrafts, live acoustic tunes, and beachside sunset seating.
activities.tips: Wednesdays host the full flea market; other days enjoy the relaxed beach shacks.

activities.name: Palolem Beach & Sea Kayaking
activities.short_desc: Crescent-shaped gentle bay in South Goa ideal for beginner sea kayaking and dolphin spotting.
activities.tips: Early morning sea is calmest; life jackets are mandatory and included.

activities.name: Chapora Fort & Vagator Sunset
activities.short_desc: Famous red laterite fort ramparts with dramatic views over the Chapora River mouth and ocean.
activities.tips: Wear shoes with good grip for the rocky walk up the slope.

activities.name: Dudhsagar Waterfalls Jeep Excursion
activities.short_desc: Four-tiered massive cascade amidst Bhagwan Mahaveer Wildlife Sanctuary with forested off-road trail.
activities.tips: Forest department permits and life jackets are arranged at the Kulem jeep counter.

name: Munnar
tagline: Misty rolling hills, emerald tea gardens, and fresh mountain air.
overview: Set at 1,600 meters in the Western Ghats, Munnar is known for sprawling tea estates, cool climate, trekking trails, and wildlife reserves.

activities.name: KDHP Tea Museum & Factory Tour
activities.short_desc: Learn about the century-old orthodox tea-making process with live demonstration and tea tasting.
activities.tips: Try fresh cardamom tea and purchase unadulterated estate grade tea.

activities.name: Eravikulam National Park (Rajamalai)
activities.short_desc: Home to the endangered Nilgiri Tahr and rolling shola grass hills leading towards Anamudi Peak.
activities.tips: Book entry tickets online in advance; eco-friendly safari buses take you up the hill.

activities.name: Mattupetty Dam & Echo Point
activities.short_desc: Scenic reservoir framed by pine groves; speed boating and natural acoustic echo phenomenon.
activities.tips: Local vendors sell freshly sliced spiced pineapples and steamed corn.

activities.name: Top Station Viewpoint
activities.short_desc: The highest altitude point on Munnar-Kodaikanal road offering 360-degree views over Tamil Nadu plains.
activities.tips: Carry a light windbreaker jacket; clouds frequently roll across the ridge.

activities.name: Punarjani Traditional Martial Arts & Kathakali Show
activities.short_desc: Mesmerizing display of Kerala's ancient martial art (Kalaripayattu) and classical Kathakali dance.
activities.tips: Arrive 20 minutes early to watch the intricate facial makeup process.

activities.name: Lockhart Gap Trek & Spice Garden
activities.short_desc: Gentle hillside trail passing through fragrant cardamom plantations and panoramic cliff viewpoints.
activities.tips: Wear sturdy walking shoes with good tread for damp morning terrain.

activities.name: Munnar Town Spice & Homemade Chocolate Market
activities.short_desc: Bustling town center with shops selling genuine cloves, cinnamon, vanilla pods, and dark chocolates.
activities.tips: Look for cooperative government spice outlets for verified grading.

name: Manali
tagline: Snow-capped peaks, cedar forests, and Himalayan river adventure.
overview: Nestled in the Beas River valley, Manali is a gateway for high-altitude trekking, paragliding, pine-scented mountain walks, and mountain cafe culture.

activities.name: Hadimba Devi Temple & Cedar Forest
activities.short_desc: Unique 1553 CE pagoda-style wooden temple sheltered inside towering Dhungri deodar forests.
activities.tips: Visit early to experience the morning mist among the hundred-year-old cedars.

activities.name: Solang Valley Adventures
activities.short_desc: High meadow famous for ropeway cable car rides, paragliding, and winter snow activities.
activities.tips: Cable car offers safe and breathtaking aerial valley views without requiring extreme sports.

activities.name: Old Manali Village & Artisanal Cafes
activities.short_desc: Quaint village lined with traditional wood-and-stone Himachali houses, apple orchards, and bakeries.
activities.tips: Try wood-fired pizza and fresh Himalayan trout at riverside eateries.

activities.name: Vashisht Natural Hot Springs & Jogini Waterfall Hike
activities.short_desc: Natural sulfur hot water baths followed by a scenic 3 km pine trail hike to Jogini falls.
activities.tips: The hike is moderate; carry a reusable water bottle and wear good hiking shoes.

activities.name: Mall Road & Tibetan Monastery Market
activities.short_desc: Pedestrianized high street offering Kullu shawls, wooden craft, Tibetan prayer wheels, and momos.
activities.tips: Only official government handloom emporiums guarantee pure wool pashmina.

activities.name: Naggar Castle & Roerich Art Gallery
activities.short_desc: 500-year-old timber and stone fortress overlooking the Beas river, once seat of the Kullu Rajas.
activities.tips: Located 20 km from Manali; peaceful alternative to busy tourist pockets.

name: Varanasi
tagline: One of the world's oldest living cities, sacred ghats, and spiritual rhythm.
overview: Set along the banks of the sacred river Ganges, Varanasi offers profound spiritual rituals, sunrise boat rides, winding alleys, classical music, and rich silk handlooms.

activities.name: Sunrise Ganga Boat Ride (Assi to Manikarnika)
activities.short_desc: Rowing boat at dawn witnessing morning prayers, bathing rituals, and historic stone ghats.
activities.tips: Start at 5:30 AM to catch the quiet dawn light and chanting over the river.

activities.name: Kashi Vishwanath Temple & Corridor Walk
activities.short_desc: Revered Jyotirlinga shrine with the modern pedestrian corridor connecting directly to the Ganga.
activities.tips: Electronic devices and bags must be deposited in official lockers before entry.

activities.name: Sarnath Buddhist Stupa & Archeological Museum
activities.short_desc: Historic deer park where Gautama Buddha taught his first sermon; site of the Ashoka Pillar.
activities.tips: Museum is closed on Fridays; displays the original Ashoka Lion Capital.

activities.name: Dashashwamedh Ghat Evening Ganga Aarti
activities.short_desc: Synchronized ritual of brass lamps, conch shells, and devotional hymns by young priests.
activities.tips: Secure steps seat by 6:00 PM or view from an anchored wooden boat.

activities.name: Thatheri Bazar Street Food & Lassi Trail
activities.short_desc: Taste authentic Banarasi kachori-sabzi, tamatar chaat, and creamy clay-cup Blue Lassi.
activities.tips: Tamatar chaat at Kashi Chaat Bhandar is freshly cooked every evening after 4:30 PM.

activities.name: Banarasi Silk Weavers Workshop Visit
activities.short_desc: Watch master handloom weavers craft pure zari brocade sarees and wall tapestries.
activities.tips: Support authentic weaver cooperatives in the Madanpura or Peeli Kothi quarters.

name: Pondicherry
tagline: French colonial quarters, tranquil sea promenade, and spiritual retreats.
overview: Pondicherry combines French boulevard symmetry, bright bougainvillea-framed villas, Tamil heritage, artisanal bakeries, and experimental community living at Auroville.

activities.name: Rock Beach & Promenade Morning Cycle Ride
activities.short_desc: Traffic-free morning coastal boulevard with refreshing sea breezes and French memorial statues.
activities.tips: Vehicle entry is restricted during morning hours, making it perfect for cycling or walking.

activities.name: Auroville & Matrimandir Viewing Point
activities.short_desc: International township dedicated to human unity; walk through shade trees to the golden geodesic sphere.
activities.tips: Visitor center passes are free; inner chamber meditation requires booking days ahead.

activities.name: White Town Heritage Walk & French Cafes
activities.short_desc: Cobbled streets lined with colonial mansions, boutique shops, and authentic French creperies.
activities.tips: Stop for warm croissants and espresso at Baker Street or Cafe des Arts.

activities.name: Sri Aurobindo Ashram
activities.short_desc: Serene spiritual haven and library centered around the marble Samadhi surrounded by flowers.
activities.tips: Maintains deep silence; footwear must be left at the designated entrance stand.

activities.name: Chunnambar Boat House to Paradise Beach
activities.short_desc: Backwater ferry ride through mangrove fringes leading to an isolated golden sand spit.
activities.tips: Last return ferry is around 5:00 PM; wear sun protection.

activities.name: Goubert Market & Tamil Quarter Crafts
activities.short_desc: Vibrant local market for fresh spices, jasmine garlands, handmade paper, and ceramic goods.
activities.tips: Visit Sri Aurobindo Handmade Paper Factory nearby for eco-friendly stationery.

name: Udaipur
tagline: The City of Lakes, romantic ghats, and Mewar palaces.
overview: Surrounded by the Aravalli hills, Udaipur is celebrated for Lake Pichola, intricate marble palaces, heritage rooftop dining, and folk music traditions.

activities.name: Udaipur City Palace Complex
activities.short_desc: Massive granite and marble palace overlooking Lake Pichola with mirror-inlaid courtyards.
activities.tips: Start early to avoid mid-day queues in the narrow corridors.

activities.name: Lake Pichola Sunset Boat Cruise & Jagmandir
activities.short_desc: Gliding across calm waters as the sun illuminates the white marble Lake Palace and ghats.
activities.tips: Sunset departure around 4:45 PM offers the most dramatic golden hour reflections.

activities.name: Saheliyon-ki-Bari (Courtyard of Maidens)
activities.short_desc: Lush royal gardens featuring marble elephants, lotus pools, and gravity-fed natural fountains.
activities.tips: A peaceful shady oasis during warm afternoons.

activities.name: Bagore Ki Haveli Dharohar Folk Dance Show
activities.short_desc: High-energy Rajasthani folk performance featuring fire dancers, puppets, and pot-balancing.
activities.tips: Show starts at 7:00 PM; ticket counter opens at 6:15 PM and fills quickly.

activities.name: Monsoon Palace (Sajjangarh) Hilltop
activities.short_desc: High hilltop fort overlooking the entire lake basin and surrounding wildlife sanctuary.
activities.tips: Shared electric shuttles operate from the sanctuary gate to the fort peak.

activities.name: Jagdish Temple & Old City Bazaar Trail
activities.short_desc: 1651 Indo-Aryan temple with sculpted pillars, leading to silver jewelers and miniature painting artists.
activities.tips: Local miniature painters often demonstrate squirrel-hair brush techniques willingly.

name: Rishikesh
tagline: Yoga capital of the world, Himalayan foothills, and river rapids.
overview: Where the emerald Ganga emerges from the Himalayas, Rishikesh draws rafters, yoga practitioners, backpackers, and seekers of mountain peace.

activities.name: Ganga White Water Rafting (Shivpuri to NIM Beach)
activities.short_desc: Exhilarating 16 km river run tackling Grade III rapids including Roller Coaster and Golf Course.
activities.tips: Always book with government-licensed operators; wetsuits and life vests are mandatory.

activities.name: The Beatles Ashram (Chaurasi Kutia)
activities.short_desc: Forest retreat where the Beatles stayed in 1968; features stone meditation domes and mural art.
activities.tips: Located inside Rajaji Tiger Reserve boundary; peaceful forest walks surrounded by birds.

activities.name: Parmarth Niketan Ganga Aarti & Kirtan
activities.short_desc: Uplifting sunset ceremony with Vedic chants, music, and floating diya offerings on the river.
activities.tips: Arrive around 5:30 PM to sit near the Shiva statue on the river steps.

activities.name: Neer Garh Waterfall Hike
activities.short_desc: Tiered natural waterfall cascade with cool plunge pools tucked behind the mountain road.
activities.tips: The upper third pool has fewer visitors and crystal clear fresh spring water.

activities.name: Tapovan Organic Cafes & Yoga Session
activities.short_desc: Drop-in Hatha yoga class followed by wholesome smoothie bowls and herbal teas overlooking the valley.
activities.tips: Many studios welcome casual walk-in students without prior registration.

activities.name: Kunjapuri Devi Sunrise Himalayan View
activities.short_desc: Peak shrine at 1,665 meters with panoramic sunrise views over snow-capped Gangotri peaks.
activities.tips: Depart town at 4:30 AM; you can hike down through village trails back to Tapovan.
